claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM, ketanserin is unlikely to kill cells through its annotated serotonin/adrenergic receptor antagonism; any modest, non-selective antiproliferative effect would most plausibly reflect a cationic amphiphilic lysosomal/off-target effect rather than a receptor-mediated cytotoxic mechanism.
